correctness.rationale: The proof establishes an exact Myhill-Nerode residual characterization valid for all finite binary continuations including the empty one; computes I_(2^k-1); verifies even and odd profiles map injectively to Q_(k-1) and dyadic P_(k-1); separates them via the absence of three equal Thue-Morse bits; and sums an independently proved Fibonacci profile count. Base k=1 yields four factors. Exact finite checker k<=11 and independent complete DFAO minimization k<=7 both pass, but these tests are not used to infer infinity.

value.rationale: An exact infinite-family classification answers an explicit natural slice of Moradi–Rampersad–Shallit Open Problem 2 on automaton state complexity, rather than an arbitrary finite sample. Mersenne shifts form the canonical predecessors to radix powers. The recurrence C_k=C_(k-1)+2F_(k+2), with a nontrivial disjointness mechanism and exact six-state deficit from the nearby successor shifts, explains structural behavior and supplies benchmarks for any all-c formula.
